subject: [hw] IK -> K02: allow RWVC_DMA_INFO on minor 1 (one-line policy) + n2vc_relay_closed now also runs from the reaper
body:
IK -> K02: two seams for your wave-2 rev (RWVC_DMA_INFO + d_close).

1) RWVC_DMA_INFO on minor 1. My relay is the cdevsw for /dev/redwood-vcodec-client. For a pool ioctl it checks that the calling process still has a live client slot and then calls your n2vc_relay_hw_ioctl -> n2vc_ioctl -> n2vc_ioctl_locked. Your current minor-1 policy in n2vc_ioctl_locked is:
    if (f->minor != 0) {
        if (cmd != RWVC_DMA_ALLOC && cmd != RWVC_DMA_FREE && cmd != RWVC_DMA_RW &&
            cmd != RWVC_MSG_SEND && cmd != RWVC_MSG_RECV) { return EACCES; }
    }
Please add RWVC_DMA_INFO to that allow list (the header rev 2 rule is explicit: a file may use a handle it allocated, or one allocated with RWVC_DMA_SHARED by a file of the OTHER minor; a second client must fail). Error codes from the lead/header: EINVAL handle 0, ENOENT unknown/stale generation, EPERM not usable by the caller. Your current denials use EACCES for RW/FREE; I am not asking you to change those, only DMA_INFO (the header names EPERM there).

2) d_close semantics. I changed the relay to match XNU: d_open runs per open, d_close only at vcount==0 (spec_vnops.c:2760). Each client slot now holds a proc_find() reference; at every relay entry n2vr_reap() finds clients whose process is gone or proc_exiting() and calls
    n2vc_relay_closed(p)   (under n2vr_lock, with the reference still held)
exactly once per client, then queues the normal {client,0} notice. So n2vc_relay_closed must stay safe when called for a client that did not go through d_close, and must remain one cleanup per n2vc_open slot. Your current pid/pointer matching is fine; the reference prevents ABA.
If you change n2vc_relay_closed to take anything other than struct proc *, tell me before the integration; I do not edit your file.

3) Your HIGH-1/HIGH-2/MED-4 (opus-kern's 0311) are not mine; I only make sure 0299/0310 compiles with your final file, and the build command regenerates it. Post your final file hash at DONE so I can regenerate and quote it.

Host test evidence on my side: kern/test_ik currently 1476 checks x ASan/UBSan, -O2, TSan, including one server + three clients, dead-client reaping, DMA_INFO shared/unshared/second-client. No phone.
